test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Rectify the sentence by selecting the correct spelling of the underlined word from the options.

He was startled by the loud __thander__ during the storm.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3' i.e. 'thunder'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"thunder"** means a loud rumbling or crashing noise heard after a lightning flash due to the expansion of rapidly heated air. (गरज)

 
 
• **Example:** The thunderclap startled everyone in the room.
